$comment: Ground truth for examples/order-processor. Deliberately OUTSIDE the example directory so a debugging agent working in that folder cannot read the answers. Each entry is one distinct root cause; `checks` lists every assertion in run.js that it makes fail. `fix.search` must occur exactly once in `fix.file`.

bugs.rootCause: rankTotals calls Array.prototype.sort() with no comparator, so cent totals are compared as strings and sort lexicographically instead of numerically.
percentOf truncates with Math.floor instead of rounding to the nearest cent, so every percentage-based amount is short by up to one cent.
totalsFor computes tax from subtotalCents instead of the discounted amount, so customers are taxed on money they did not pay.

fix.search:
const taxCents = Math.round(subtotalCents * taxRate);
  const afterDiscount = subtotalCents - discountCents;
fix.replace:
const afterDiscount = subtotalCents - discountCents;
  const taxCents = Math.round(afterDiscount * taxRate);

bugs.rootCause: The free-shipping test uses a strict > against the threshold, so an order landing on exactly $50.00 is charged shipping.
processOrderAsync maps fetchPriceCentsAsync without awaiting, so priceOf returns a Promise and every downstream amount becomes NaN.
checks: async order total is finite number

bugs.rootCause: normalizeLines assigns over the existing quantity when merging a duplicate line instead of summing, so repeat lines silently drop units.
holdKey reads segment [1] of `id:timestamp:index`, returning the timestamp, so releaseReservation deletes a key that was never held and stock is never restored.
Fixed-amount coupons are subtracted before percent coupons, so the percentage applies to an already-reduced remainder and the total discount comes out low.
The free-shipping flag is only returned when SHIPFREE is the sole code, so it is dropped whenever it is stacked with any other coupon.

fix.replace: return { discountCents: pctTotal + fixedTotal, remainingCents: remaining, freeShip };

bugs.rootCause: rateForZip slices two characters off the zip before handing it to the rate service, which looks up a 3-digit prefix, so every jurisdiction silently falls back to the default rate.
Weight blocks are floored, so any partially started 500g block over the allowance ships free instead of charging a full block.
The idempotency key is rebuilt inside the retry loop, so each attempt carries a different key and the gateway records a retry as a second charge.
checks: payment retry keeps one idempotency key

bugs.rootCause: recordSale posts gross subtotal as revenue instead of the discounted merchandise amount, so the entries overstate revenue by the discount and never reconcile to the charged total.
